description: Queue the render of a stills post again when stills_get says render.state is failed (or retrying and nothing is moving). The layout, its revision, the post's versions and approvals stay as they are: the slides already drawn are kept and the job carries on after them. A render that is done or current is returned unchanged. Pass base_rev (the rev you last read) so a layout changed meanwhile is refused.

schema_version.description: The stills document version the app speaks (3 now; leave out for 1). An older app gets documents in its own version, or an UPDATE_REQUIRED refusal when the layout uses something only a newer version can hold.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: stills_render_retry
title: Draw a stills post again
